observations.quote: Apple's shares rose 1.2% on Monday, lifting the iPhone maker's market capitalization to a record $4.95 trillion. Nvidia, meanwhile, fell 5%, reducing its market value to $4.78 trillion, after Bloomberg reported that the cost of insuring the chipmaker's debt against default had risen by a record amount amid concerns over its growing commitments to AI infrastructure investments.
observations.one_line: 2026年7月27日，Apple股价上涨1.2%，市值达到4.95万亿美元纪录；Nvidia股价下跌5%，市值降至4.78万亿美元，报道将其与AI基础设施投资承诺引发的信用担忧联系起来。
observations.speaker: Shir Reiter，Ctech记者；其中保险成本信息归因于Bloomberg
observations.original_who: Shir Reiter；保险成本信息最初来自Bloomberg

observations.quote: Nvidia, widely viewed as the biggest beneficiary of the AI investment boom, had held the title of the world's most valuable company for more than a year after surpassing Microsoft in June 2025. But its valuation has compressed in recent months. The company now trades at a forward price-to-earnings multiple of 18.2, down from 25.5 at the beginning of the year.
observations.one_line: 截至2026年7月28日，报道指出Nvidia远期市盈率为18.2倍，低于年初的25.5倍；公司自2025年6月超过Microsoft后曾连续一年多位居全球市值最高公司。
observations.speaker: Shir Reiter，Ctech记者

observations.quote: Concerns intensified after the Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia is in talks to provide $250 billion in financing to OpenAI as part of a data center project in Ohio. According to Jefferies, investors view the proposed arrangement as a prominent example of "circular financing," in which financing provided by a supplier ultimately helps generate demand for its own products.
observations.one_line: 截至2026年7月28日，媒体报道称Nvidia正洽谈为OpenAI俄亥俄州数据中心项目提供2500亿美元融资；Jefferies称投资者将拟议安排视为供应商融资促成自身产品需求的“循环融资”案例。
observations.speaker: Shir Reiter，Ctech记者；安排消息归因于《华尔街日报》，投资者观点归因于Jefferies
observations.original_who: 《华尔街日报》（洽谈消息）；Jefferies（投资者观点）

observations.quote: Nvidia also came under pressure after the IPO of Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT triggered a sharp selloff across the semiconductor sector. Investors fear a new Chinese competitor could erode the pricing power of the industry's three dominant memory manufacturers, Micron, Samsung and SK Hynix.
observations.one_line: 2026年7月，中文报道将CXMT IPO后半导体板块急跌与市场担忧联系起来：新的中国竞争者可能削弱Micron、Samsung和SK Hynix的定价能力。
observations.speaker: Shir Reiter，Ctech记者

observations.quote: Last week, Alphabet raised its 2026 capital expenditure forecast, and investors expect other technology giants to follow suit.
observations.one_line: 2026年7月下旬，Alphabet上调了2026年资本开支预测；报道指出投资者预期其他科技巨头也会跟进。
observations.speaker: Shir Reiter，Ctech记者
